state:well_fed: The bowl is empty and the creature sits back on its haunches. Its belly is round and its eyes are half-closed.
state:content: It lies on its side with one paw stretched forward. A slow breath lifts the fur along its ribs.
state:rested: The creature sleeps curled in a tight circle. Its nose is tucked beneath its tail and its breathing is even.
state:bonded: It presses its head against your hand and holds still. The warmth of its skull fills your palm.
state:groomed: The coat lies flat and glossy from ear to tail. Each strand catches the light when it turns.
state:healthy: Its eyes are clear and its nose is cool. The creature moves with an easy stride that wastes no effort.
state:in_season: It stands at the window reading the air for what the season carries. The body adjusts without instruction.
state:self_known: It meets your gaze with an expression that is entirely its own. The creature has become itself.
state:remembered: It leads you to the place without hesitation. The path is worn from visits you have made together.
action:fill_bowl: You fill the bowl from the bag and set it on the stone floor. The sound of dry food hitting ceramic brings the creature running.
action:give_treat: You hold the treat between two fingers and wait. The creature takes it gently and carries it to its corner.
action:pour_water: You pour water into the dish until it catches the light. The creature drinks without lifting its head.
action:toss_ball: You toss the ball across the garden in a low arc. The creature is already moving before it leaves your hand.
action:tug_rope: You grip one end of the rope and brace. The creature digs in and pulls with a low growl that is not anger.
action:scratch_chin: You scratch beneath the chin where the fur is softest. The creature tilts its head and closes its eyes.
action:brush_coat: You draw the brush from shoulder to haunch in long strokes. Loose fur gathers on the bristles and the creature leans into the pull.
action:clean_paws: You lift each paw and wipe the mud from between the pads. The creature holds still and watches your hands.
action:dim_lamp: You turn the lamp down until only a glow remains. The creature settles deeper into its bed.
action:sing_low: You hum a low melody without words. The creature's ears rotate forward and its breathing slows.
action:open_door: You unlatch the door and the light falls in a rectangle on the floor. The creature stands in the doorway and lifts its nose.
action:wrap_blanket: You fold the blanket once and drape it over the sleeping form. The creature shifts without waking.
action:give_medicine: You squeeze the dropper into the side of its mouth. The creature swallows once and licks its nose.
action:check_pulse: You press two fingers behind the foreleg and count. The heart beats steady and the creature watches your face.
action:warm_compress: You fold the warm cloth and hold it against the belly. The creature exhales and its muscles relax under the heat.
action:clear_snow: You sweep the step and salt the path to the garden gate. The creature watches from the window and paws the glass.
action:plant_seeds: You press seeds into the damp soil while the creature digs beside you. Its nose is black with earth.
action:encourage_gently: You kneel and hold your hand low with the palm up. The creature looks at your hand and then at your face.
action:wait_patiently: You stand still and say nothing while it decides. The creature shifts its weight from paw to paw and watches.
action:firm_command: You speak one word clearly and hold the gesture. The creature's ears flatten and then lift as it understands.
action:reward_success: You press the clicker and offer the treat at the same moment. The creature connects the sound to the act.
action:revisit_spot: You walk the old route that curves past the oak and down to the stream. The creature's pace quickens at each remembered turn.
action:offer_old_toy: You pull the worn toy from the drawer where it has been for months. The creature's nose goes to it before your hand is still.
action:repeat_routine: You follow the same order as yesterday: bowl, water, collar, door. The creature anticipates each step before you take it.
mood:happy_wag: The tail moves in wide sweeps that rock its entire back half. Its mouth is open and its tongue hangs to the left.
mood:calm_sigh: It exhales through its nose and rests its chin on its paws. The eyes remain open but unfocused.
mood:eager_bounce: All four feet leave the ground at once. It spins once and faces you with its weight forward.
mood:low_whine: A thin sound comes from behind closed teeth. The creature looks at the bowl and back at you.
mood:drowsy_blink: Each blink takes longer than the last. The head dips and catches itself twice before settling.
mood:curious_sniff: The nose works in quick pulses, reading the air in layers. One ear turns toward the sound the other has already tracked.
mood:anxious_pace: It walks from door to window and back without stopping. Its nails click on the floor in a broken rhythm.
mood:playful_crouch: The front end drops while the back stays high. The tail vibrates and the eyes lock on the toy.
mood:warm_lean: It leans its full weight against your leg and does not move. You feel its ribs expand with each breath.
mood:proud_prance: It carries the stick high and trots with exaggerated steps. It will not put it down until you notice.
mood:sick_shiver: A fine tremor runs along the spine and the ears lie flat. The creature curls tighter and presses its nose between its paws.
mood:slow_recovery: It lifts its head for the first time since morning. The eyes are clear again and it accepts water from your hand.
mood:spring_excitement: It stands in the open doorway with its nose high, reading the new warmth. Its whole body vibrates with the change.
mood:winter_huddle: It presses against the hearthstone and tucks its paws beneath its chest. The fur puffs at the neck against the cold.
mood:autumn_mellow: It sits among fallen leaves and does not chase them. The gaze is soft and the breathing is slow.
mood:shy_retreat: It steps behind your leg and peers out with one eye. The body is low and the tail curls under.
mood:confident_strut: It walks ahead of you with its head high and its stride even. It checks back once to see that you are following.
mood:stubborn_stand: It plants all four feet and will not move. The eyes are steady and the jaw is set.
mood:gentle_acceptance: It lies down slowly and places its chin on your foot. The resistance has passed and what remains is trust.
mood:recognition_spark: Its head lifts suddenly and the ears come forward. Something in this place is known from before.
mood:nostalgic_sigh: It lies in the spot where it always lay and breathes out long and slow. The body remembers the shape of rest.
mood:wary_recall: It stops mid-step and the hackles rise for one breath. Then the head turns toward you and the fur settles.
location:cozy_den: The den is a hollow of blankets in the corner of the room. The walls are warm and the light is filtered.
location:sunny_garden: The garden is small and walled with stone. Sun falls on the grass in a shifting pattern through the leaves.
location:kitchen_corner: The kitchen corner holds two bowls on a mat. The stone floor is cool and the creature's nails tap on it.
location:warm_hearth: The hearth holds a low fire that pops and settles. The creature lies as close as the heat allows.
location:muddy_path: The path runs along the fence and collects rain. Paw prints overlap in the soft ground.
location:wash_basin: The basin sits on a low stand with a folded towel beside it. Warm water steams in the morning air.
location:front_step: The front step overlooks the lane and catches the morning light. The creature sits here and watches everything pass.
location:soft_bed: The bed is raised off the floor and lined with wool. A dip in the centre marks where the creature sleeps.
location:vet_clinic: The clinic smells of antiseptic and other animals. The creature presses against your leg and watches the door.
location:winter_room: The small room off the kitchen holds a stove and a thick rug. In winter the creature sleeps here with the door ajar.
location:garden_shed: The shed holds pots, string, and stacked seed trays. Cobwebs connect the rafters and the creature sniffs each corner.
location:porch_swing: The porch swing faces west and catches the afternoon light. The creature lies beneath it and watches the shadows lengthen.
location:training_yard: The yard behind the house has a flat patch of grass worn bare. This is where the creature learned to sit and stay.
location:old_walking_route: The path curves past the oak and down to the stream. Every stone is familiar and the creature needs no lead.
context:rain_outside: Rain strikes the windows in gusts and the garden is grey. The creature watches from the doorway but does not go out.
context:warm_sun: Sunlight moves across the floor in a slow band. The creature follows it and lies in each new patch.
context:cool_breeze: A breeze comes through the open window and lifts the curtain edge. The creature's nose twitches and its ears prick.
context:quiet_house: The house is still and the only sound is the clock. The creature's breathing is the loudest thing in the room.
context:visitor_knock: A knock comes at the door and the creature is on its feet. Its ears are forward and its tail begins to move.
context:snow_falling: Snow falls past the window in slow diagonal lines. The creature presses its nose to the cold glass.
context:fresh_air: The door is open and the air smells of cut grass and distance. The creature stands at the threshold with its weight forward.
context:thunder_rumble: A low rumble crosses the sky and the windows rattle. The creature moves to the nearest person and presses close.
context:birdsong: Birds call from the garden wall in short repeating phrases. The creature's head tracks left and right, calculating distance.
context:firelight: The fire has burned down to embers that pulse orange and grey. The creature's fur glows along the edges.
context:spring_bloom: The garden has turned green overnight and small flowers push through the mulch. The creature circles each new scent.
context:autumn_chill: The air bites at the ears and the light has a copper edge. Leaves skitter across the step and the creature watches them pass.
context:first_frost: Ice patterns cover the inside of the window glass. The creature breathes a small fog and the water bowl has a skin of ice.
context:morning_dew: Dew covers every blade and the paw prints darken the grass. The creature shakes each foot in turn and sniffs the wet.
context:familiar_scent: The creature stops mid-stride and lifts its nose. Something in the air is old and known and it reads it carefully.
context:new_place_smell: Every surface is unfamiliar and the creature catalogues each scent. The body is tense but the tail is level.
object:food_bowl: The ceramic bowl sits on the mat with a chip on the rim. The inside is worn smooth from use.
object:water_dish: The water dish is heavy stoneware and holds a day's supply. A single hair floats on the surface.
object:rubber_ball: The ball is red and has lost its bounce on one side. The creature finds it under furniture by smell.
object:knotted_rope: The rope is braided cotton with two knots at each end. The middle section is damp and frayed from pulling.
object:soft_blanket: The blanket is wool and carries the creature's scent. One corner is darker from being chewed.
object:bristle_brush: The brush has natural bristles set in a wooden back. Loose fur clings between the rows.
object:small_bone: The bone is dried and pale and fits in one paw. It is carried from room to room and hidden in blankets.
object:worn_collar: The collar is leather with a brass buckle. The inside is smooth from wear and the tag is scratched.
object:squeaky_duck: The duck is yellow rubber and makes a sound when bitten. The creature carries it everywhere after rain.
object:pillow_nest: The pillow is dented in the centre where the creature curls. A ring of shed fur marks the edge.
object:medicine_dropper: The glass dropper holds a measured dose in amber liquid. The creature turns its head away at the smell.
object:wool_scarf: The scarf is knitted and wraps twice around the neck. The creature tolerates it in exchange for going outside.
object:fallen_leaf: A single brown leaf spins across the step. The creature pounces and pins it, then loses interest.
object:old_toy: The toy is faded and one ear is torn. The creature found it in a drawer and carried it to its bed without playing.
object:worn_path: The path is lighter where the paws have worn the grass. It leads from the gate to the oak and back.
object:familiar_bowl: This bowl was the first one it ate from. The shape is known by feel and the creature goes to it by habit.
object:training_clicker: The small plastic box makes a single sharp sound. The creature's ears lift and its eyes find yours immediately.
need:belly_rumble: A small sound comes from the creature's middle. It looks toward the kitchen and then at you.
need:restless_pacing: It cannot settle in any position for more than a minute. The tail swishes low and the eyes are wide.
need:lonely_cry: A single high note hangs in the room after you leave. It fades and comes again at intervals.
need:itchy_scratch: The back leg pumps against the shoulder in rapid bursts. The creature stops and starts and cannot quite reach.
need:yawn_stretch: The mouth opens wide enough to show every tooth. The front legs extend and the spine drops in a long curve.
need:play_nudge: It pushes the ball toward your foot with its nose. When you look down it steps back and waits.
need:runny_nose: A clear drop forms at the nostril and the creature sniffs constantly. Its breathing has a faint whistle.
need:bright_fever: The ears are hot to the touch and the eyes are glassy. The creature lies flat and does not lift its head.
need:cold_snap_ache: The creature moves stiffly after lying still. Its joints creak audibly when it stretches in the cold air.
need:approval_seeking: It performs the trick without being asked and then looks up. The eyes search your face for the response it expects.
need:comfort_seeking: It brings the old toy to you and lies down with it between its paws. It does not play but holds it close.
trait:gentle_nature: It approaches every new creature with its head low and its tail slow. The gentleness is not learned; it is given.
trait:stubborn_streak: When it does not want to move, no force will shift it. The stubbornness passes, but only on its own time.
trait:eager_learner: It watches your hands with total attention, waiting for the signal. Each new command is absorbed in two repetitions.
trait:cautious_step: It tests each new surface before committing its weight. The caution is not fear; it is thoroughness.
trait:bold_approach: It walks toward the unfamiliar without slowing. The body is forward-leaning and the ears are up.
trait:loyal_shadow: It follows you from room to room without being called. The distance between you is never more than a body length.
memory:favorite_spot: The creature returns to the same spot by the hearth every evening. The rug shows the shape of its body.
memory:feared_sound: A particular pitch makes the creature freeze and its ears drop. The sound is remembered from a time before you.
memory:trusted_hand: It places its chin in the palm of a hand it has known since the beginning. The weight of its head is total surrender.
memory:learned_trick: When the word is spoken, the body responds before the mind catches up. The trick has been rehearsed into instinct.
memory:old_comfort: It carries the worn blanket to a new place and lies on it. The scent is home, even when the walls are not.
memory:recalled_walk: At the turning in the path, the creature pulls toward the route you walked last autumn. It remembers the way.
companion:park_dog: A brown dog appears at the garden gate and stands with its tail level. The two sniff each other through the bars.
companion:window_bird: A sparrow lands on the windowsill and hops twice. The creature watches without moving, only its eyes tracking.
companion:child_visitor: A child kneels on the floor and holds out both hands. The creature approaches low and then licks once.
companion:calm_cat: The cat sits on the hearth rug with its paws tucked. The creature lies beside it without touching.
companion:vet_nurse: The nurse kneels and offers the back of her hand. The creature sniffs once and allows itself to be lifted.
companion:robin_on_fence: A robin sits on the garden fence post and sings three notes. The creature sits below and tilts its head.
companion:old_friend_dog: A grey-muzzled dog waits at the gate. The two greet each other with quiet sniffs, as if resuming a conversation.
companion:patient_trainer: The trainer kneels with a treat in one hand and patience in both. The creature learns because it is not rushed.
time:sunrise: Light enters the room from the east and moves across the floor. The creature stirs and stretches before opening its eyes.
time:midday_warmth: The sun is directly overhead and the house is warm. The creature lies flat on the cool stone.
time:golden_hour: The light turns amber and the shadows stretch long. The creature sits at the window and watches the lane.
time:dusk_settling: The sky dims and the lamps are not yet lit. The creature moves to its bed and circles twice.
time:deep_night: The house is dark and the only sound is breathing. The creature sleeps and its paws twitch in a dream.
time:early_spring: The days are growing longer and the first buds appear on the bare branches. The creature's coat begins to thin.
time:late_autumn: The light fails early and the leaves are almost gone. The creature returns from the garden sooner each evening.
event:creature_discovered: You open your eyes and the creature is already watching. It has been waiting without making a sound.
event:meal_served: You set the bowl down and step back. The creature approaches and eats without rushing.
event:walk_begun: The collar clicks shut and the door opens. The creature steps out and the whole body lifts with anticipation.
event:vet_visit: The car stops and the creature knows the smell. It presses against you in the waiting room and does not look at the other animals.
event:season_changed: Something has shifted overnight. The air is different and the creature stands at the door reading it with every sense.
event:trick_performed: The word is given and the creature responds. The movement is precise and the eyes find yours immediately after.
event:remembered_place: The creature stops and sniffs the air at the bend in the path. It has been here before and its body knows it.
decay:got_hungry: The bowl is empty and the creature keeps checking. It sits by the mat and looks at you with increasing urgency.
decay:grew_bored: It sighs and drops its chin onto its paws. The toy is right there but the toy is not enough.
decay:grew_tired: The eyes are heavy and the body lists to one side. It has been awake longer than it should.
decay:felt_lonely: It sits by the door and stares at the gap beneath. Every sound from outside makes the ears lift and fall.
decay:coat_matted: The fur sticks out at odd angles behind the ears. The creature scratches and makes it worse.
decay:caught_chill: A shiver passes along the spine and the nose feels warm. The creature curls tighter into the blanket.
decay:season_shock: The temperature changed overnight and the creature is not ready. It stands at the door and decides against it.
decay:lost_confidence: It hesitates before the jump it made yesterday without thinking. Something in the world has become less certain.
decay:stubborn_refusal: The creature has decided and no amount of persuasion will change it. The jaw is set and the body is stone.
decay:reverted_to_shy: It hides behind your legs around a person it met last week. The progress has unwound overnight.
decay:ignored_command: The word is spoken and the creature looks at you, then away. It heard and chose otherwise.
decay:forgot_briefly: It stands at the turning and does not know which way. The nose works but the memory does not come.
decay:wrong_path_chosen: It pulls confidently in the wrong direction, sure of a route that no longer exists.
decay:startled_by_familiar: The neighbour's voice makes the creature flinch. It knew this voice yesterday.
decay:routine_confused: It goes to the bowl at the wrong time and sits there puzzled. The schedule has slipped.
mischief:raided_bin: The bin is on its side and the contents are sorted by interest. The creature sits among wrappers with no remorse.
mischief:chewed_shoe: Your left shoe has a new ventilation hole. The creature greets you with the lace still hanging from its mouth.
mischief:rolled_in_mud: It returns from the garden wearing the garden. The tail wags as if this is an achievement.
mischief:stole_sock: Your sock is now a prize. The creature runs in tight circles with it, daring you to try.
mischief:pretended_not_to_hear: You called three times and the ears moved each time. The creature did not.
mischief:hid_favourite_toy: The toy has vanished and the creature knows where. It will not tell you and its face says so.
mischief:went_wrong_way: It chose the left fork with absolute conviction. This is not where you were going.
decline:empty_stare_at_bowl: It sits in front of the empty bowl and does not move. The stare is patient and infinite.
decline:dramatic_sigh: The creature lies flat on its side and exhales with its whole body. This is a creature that has known better days.
decline:door_watching: It has not moved from the door in twenty minutes. Every car that passes gets a head tilt and a tiny whine.
decline:confused_pause: It stops mid-action and looks around as if the room has rearranged itself. The pause lasts three seconds and is filled with thinking.
decline:backing_away: It was approaching, then stopped and backed up one step. The boldness has flickered out.
combo:guilty_face: It will not look directly at you. The tail wags low and the whole body curves into an apology.
combo:zoomies: Something snaps and the creature runs at full speed in a perfect circle. The eyes are wild and the tongue flies sideways.
combo:selective_deafness: It can hear a treat bag at forty paces but cannot hear its name at three feet. The condition is situational.
combo:wrong_route_joy: It is delighted to be lost. The wrong path has better smells and the creature has no complaints.
combo:sulky_corner: It has turned its back to the room and pressed its nose into the corner. This is a protest.
context:left_alone: The house is empty and the creature knows it. Every settling sound takes on a different quality.
context:skipped_meal: The clock has passed the usual time and no bowl has appeared. The creature positions itself near the bag.
context:unfamiliar_noise: A sound the creature does not recognise comes from upstairs. It freezes, one paw raised, and looks at you for guidance.
recovery:grateful_lick: After being fed it comes to find you and licks your hand once. The message is received.
recovery:forgiven_wag: After the scolding and the cleanup, the tail begins again. The grudge lasted four seconds.
recovery:confidence_rebuilt: It takes the jump again and lands cleanly. The hesitation is gone and the eyes say everything.
recovery:remembered_again: At the turning it pauses, lifts its nose, and turns right without doubt. The memory has returned.
recovery:fresh_and_clean: The coat lies smooth after the brush. The creature shakes once and struts as if wearing new clothes.
